== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The later slip substitutes starship weapons for non-artillery Weapons, gives the Star Destroyer destiny modifier without the old weapon-or-battle filter, and sets the single TIE pull during your deploy phase. Both keep the same generation, power, immunity and Interrupt restrictions.
